name: TraderTraitor (DPRK) – Nov 2026
description: Procedure-level mappings from the TraderTraitor threat actor profile. Score: 3 = high confidence, 2 = moderate.

techniques.comment: Selects developers, DevOps staff and transaction signers at exchanges and their vendors.
